title: RSH-006 as scoped (main clippy, test and doc steps) is closed
description: RSH-006 as scoped (main clippy, test and doc steps) is closed. Other cargo steps in the same file still lack --locked, so CI can still resolve versions other than Cargo.lock there. The unlocked steps are cargo hack --each-feature test (256), cargo hack check --feature-powerset (276, 280), cargo build --lib --no-default-features (316, 320) and cargo llvm-cov (535, 542-543). I did not check every run line (the test -p sc-treesitter/sc-ai steps at 262-270 and workspace-tests at 445 were not looked at).
